command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-12. Bounded inference benchmark at the commissioned 150 W envelope, with the
# telemetry #997 section 6 asks for and the fail-closed rule from section 7.
#
# Thermal safety outranks benchmark completion. The device reports slowdown at 92 C and shutdown at
# 95 C; this run aborts at 85 C, checked between every iteration, and does not ride the limit. The
# P40 is a passively cooled datacenter card in a desktop chassis with no fan of its own, so the
# interesting number is not the peak of a two-second burst -- it is whether temperature is still
# climbing after minutes of continuous work. That is why the load is sustained rather than spiky.
#
# Unmeasurable telemetry is reported as UNKNOWN, never as zero. #997 is explicit that the card must
# not self-promote from UNKNOWN capability by being present, and inventing a number is how that
# happens.

$smi = 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe'
$P40 = 'GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2'
$RTX = 'GPU-6d9ae165-7272-a38c-06b1-7276869e980f'
$work = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_install'
$tele = "$work\bench150-telemetry.csv"
$ABORT_C = 85

Write-Output '--- ENVELOPE-AND-LIMITS ---'
& $smi --query-gpu=uuid,name,driver_model.current,power.limit,power.default_limit,power.max_limit,temperature.gpu,memory.total --format=csv,noheader -i $P40
& $smi -i $P40 -q | Select-String -Pattern 'GPU Slowdown Temp|GPU Shutdown Temp|GPU Max Operating Temp|Target Temperature' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }
Write-Output '--- ECC-BEFORE (like-for-like -q -d ECC) ---'
& $smi -i $P40 -q -d ECC | Select-String -Pattern 'Ecc Mode|Current|Pending|Volatile|Aggregate|Total' | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }
Write-Output '--- PCIE-IDLE ---'
& $smi --query-gpu=pcie.link.gen.current,pcie.link.gen.max,pcie.link.width.current,pcie.link.width.max --format=csv,noheader -i $P40

Write-Output '--- START-TELEMETRY ---'
Remove-Item $tele -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$telemetryProc = Start-Process -FilePath $smi -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ArgumentList @(
    '-i', $P40,
    '--query-gpu=timestamp,temperature.gpu,power.draw,power.limit,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.used,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,pcie.link.gen.current,pcie.link.width.current,clocks_throttle_reasons.active',
    '--format=csv,noheader,nounits', '-l', '1', '-f', $tele)
Write-Output "telemetry_pid=$($telemetryProc.Id)"
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

$prompt = @'
You are reviewing a service migration. Explain, in careful detail, why a compute device that presents
no display adapter to the operating system cannot be passed through a virtualisation layer that
enumerates devices exclusively through the display driver stack, and what that implies for container
runtimes that initialise a device library before applying any device filter. Be thorough and specific.
'@

$results = @()
$aborted = $false
$model = 'qwen2.5-coder:7b'
Write-Output "--- SUSTAINED-LOAD model=$model ---"
for ($i = 1; $i -le 8; $i++) {
    $t = [double]((& $smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i $P40 | Select-Object -First 1).Trim())
    if ($t -ge $ABORT_C) {
        Write-Output "ABORT: ${t}C >= ${ABORT_C}C before iteration $i -- thermal rule stops the benchmark, evidence preserved"
        $aborted = $true; break
    }
    $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    try {
        $body = @{ model = $model; prompt = $prompt; stream = $false; options = @{ num_predict = 320; temperature = 0.2 } } | ConvertTo-Json
        $g = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate' -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 900
        $sw.Stop()
        $decode = if ($g.eval_duration -gt 0) { [math]::Round($g.eval_count / ($g.eval_duration / 1e9), 2) } else { 'UNKNOWN' }
        $prefill = if ($g.prompt_eval_duration -gt 0) { [math]::Round($g.prompt_eval_count / ($g.prompt_eval_duration / 1e9), 2) } else { 'UNKNOWN' }
        $ttft = if ($g.prompt_eval_duration -gt 0 -and $null -ne $g.load_duration) { [math]::Round(($g.load_duration + $g.prompt_eval_duration) / 1e6, 1) } else { 'UNKNOWN' }
        $after = (& $smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,power.draw,utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv,noheader -i $P40 | Select-Object -First 1)
        Write-Output "iter=$i start_temp=${t}C wall_ms=$($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds) prompt_tok=$($g.prompt_eval_count) prefill_tok_s=$prefill decode_tok=$($g.eval_count) decode_tok_s=$decode ttft_ms=$ttft :: after=$after"
        $results += [pscustomobject]@{ iter = $i; decode = $decode; prefill = $prefill }
    } catch {
        $sw.Stop()
        Write-Output "iter=$i FAILED after $($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds)ms :: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        $aborted = $true; break
    }
}

Write-Output '--- RTX-3050-DURING-AND-AFTER (must show no inference allocation) ---'
& $smi --query-gpu=uuid,name,memory.used,utilization.gpu,power.draw,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- COMPUTE-APPS-ON-P40 ---'
& $smi --query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader -i $P40
Write-Output "compute_apps_rc=$LASTEXITCODE"
Write-Output '--- API-PS ---'
try { (Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps' -TimeoutSec 20).models | ForEach-Object { "loaded=$($_.name) size=$($_.size) size_vram=$($_.size_vram)" } } catch { Write-Output "ps_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
Write-Output '--- STOP-TELEMETRY ---'
try { Stop-Process -Id $telemetryProc.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output 'telemetry stopped' } catch { Write-Output "stop_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

Write-Output '--- TELEMETRY-SUMMARY ---'
$rows = Get-Content $tele -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_ -match ',' }
Write-Output "samples=$($rows.Count)"
if ($rows.Count -gt 0) {
    $parsed = $rows | ForEach-Object {
        $f = $_ -split ',\s*'
        [pscustomobject]@{ temp = [double]$f[1]; power = [double]$f[2]; util = [double]$f[4]; mem = [double]$f[6]; sm = $f[7]; gen = $f[9]; width = $f[10]; throttle = $f[11] }
    }
    $loaded = $parsed | Where-Object { $_.util -gt 0 }
    Write-Output "temp_min=$(($parsed.temp | Measure-Object -Minimum).Minimum) temp_max=$(($parsed.temp | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum) temp_mean=$([math]::Round(($parsed.temp | Measure-Object -Average).Average,1))"
    Write-Output "power_max=$(($parsed.power | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum)W power_mean_under_load=$(if ($loaded) { [math]::Round(($loaded.power | Measure-Object -Average).Average,1) } else { 'UNKNOWN' })W"
    Write-Output "util_max=$(($parsed.util | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum)% mem_max=$(($parsed.mem | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum)MiB"
    Write-Output "sm_clock_max=$(($parsed.sm | Sort-Object { [int]$_ } | Select-Object -Last 1)) pcie_gen_seen=$(($parsed.gen | Sort-Object -Unique) -join '/') pcie_width_seen=$(($parsed.width | Sort-Object -Unique) -join '/')"
    Write-Output "throttle_reasons_seen=$(($parsed.throttle | Sort-Object -Unique) -join ' | ')"
    Write-Output '--- LAST-20-SAMPLES ---'
    $rows | Select-Object -Last 20
}

Write-Output '--- ECC-AFTER (like-for-like) ---'
& $smi -i $P40 -q -d ECC | Select-String -Pattern 'Ecc Mode|Current|Pending|Volatile|Aggregate|Total' | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }
Write-Output '--- SERVICE-HEALTH-AFTER-BENCH ---'
Write-Output "task=$((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama').State)"
Write-Output "aborted=$aborted"
$b = Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesData\ollama\models\blobs' -File | Measure-Object -Sum Length
Write-Output "models blobs=$($b.Count) bytes=$($b.Sum)"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
